def process(nifcWildfires, noaaMonthlyStats) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    # NIFC: parse numeric and filter since 2000
    nifc = nifcWildfires.copy()
    nifc['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(nifc['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    nifc['Fires'] = (
        nifc['Fires']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    )
    nifc['Fires'] = pd.to_numeric(nifc['Fires'], errors='coerce')
    nifc = nifc[(nifc['Year'] >= 2000) & nifc['Year'].notna()].copy()
    nifcAnnual = nifc[['Year', 'Fires']].rename(columns={'Fires': 'nifcFires'})

    # NOAA: derive year from YYYYMM in Date, sum monthly Number of Fires, filter since 2000
    noaa = noaaMonthlyStats.copy()
    noaa = noaa.rename(columns=lambda c: c.strip())
    # Handle both 'Number of Fires' and possible variants
    fireColCandidates = [c for c in noaa.columns if c.lower().replace(' ', '') in ['numberoffires', 'fires']]
    fireCol = fireColCandidates[0] if fireColCandidates else 'Number of Fires'

    noaa['Date'] = pd.to_numeric(noaa['Date'], errors='coerce')
    noaa['Year'] = (noaa['Date'] // 100).astype('Int64')
    noaa[fireCol] = pd.to_numeric(noaa[fireCol], errors='coerce')
    noaa = noaa[(noaa['Year'] >= 2000) & noaa['Year'].notna()].copy()

    noaaAnnual = (
        noaa.groupby('Year', as_index=False)[fireCol]
        .sum(min_count=1)
        .rename(columns={fireCol: 'noaaFires'})
    )

    # Compare only years available in both series
    merged = noaaAnnual.merge(nifcAnnual, on='Year', how='inner')
    merged['diff'] = merged['noaaFires'] - merged['nifcFires']

    avgDiff = merged['diff'].mean()

    return pd.DataFrame([
        {
            'avgNoaaMinusNifcSince2000': float(avgDiff),
            'yearsCompared': int(merged.shape[0]),
            'rounded': int(round(avgDiff))
        }
    ])
